answer: Reaching the timber of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. Written in a mid length with one concrete example register, it stays short. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. Each submission hangs on the jetty of a task receipt, and the tundra is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. The design leans on web-of-trust with decaying edges, forfeited on duplicate submission, auditors are drawn from a rotating pool.
